newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul factory fire under control, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul factory fire under control, no casualties.

text.p: A gas explosion started a fire at an Istanbul cosmetics factory on Tuesday but the blaze was brought under control and there were no casualties or serious environmental damage, officials said.
"The fire has been brought under control...There are no casualties. There is no grave damage to the environment," a security official told Reuters by telephone.
Private NTV said there were no workers in the plant at the time.
Local officials said a 10-tonne liquid gas tank exploded at the Matsan cosmetics factory in the district of Pendik, starting the fire, setting off smaller blasts and spreading the flames.
Television pictures showed black smoke rising and fire crews from surrounding districts going to the scene, an industrial district on the outskirts of Istanbul's Asian shore.
